title: Torsion-free modules over valuation rings are flat
statement: Let $A$ be a valuation ring, meaning an integral domain such that for every nonzero element $a$ of its fraction field either $a$ or $a^{-1}$ belongs to $A$. Let $M$ be an $A$-module. If $M$ is torsion-free, meaning that $am=0$ for nonzero $a\in A$ implies $m=0$, then $M$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
